zh: (1903-66) an English writer of novels which are greatly admired for their elegant style and humour. In novels such as Decline and Fall (1928) and A Handful of Dust (1934), he made fun of the upper class and upper middle class in England in the 1920s and 1930s. His travels in Africa provided the ideas for novels such as Black Mischief (1932) and Scoop (1938). In 1930 he became a Roman Catholic and his interest in Catholic beliefs is shown in the more serious novel Brideshead Revisited (1945), about an upper-class English Roman Catholic family. Waugh's other books include a series of three with the title Sword of Honour (1952-61), based on his experiences as a soldier in the Second World War. He had a reputation as a bad-tempered, rude man with fixed, rather right-wing views.

zh: the act of bringing a feeling, a memory or an image into your mind
en: the act of bringing a feeling, a memory or an image into your mind
ex: a brilliant evocation of childhood in the 1940s
唤起对 20 世纪 40 年代童年生活的美好回忆

zh: 引起记忆的；唤起感情的
en: making you think of or remember a strong image or feeling, in a pleasant way
ex: evocative smells/sounds/music
引起回忆的气味／声音／音乐

zh: 引起记忆的；唤起感情的
en: in a way that makes you think of or remember a strong image or feeling, in a pleasant way
ex: He writes evocatively about his upbringing.
他回想起他的成长经历。

zh: 引起，唤起（感情、记忆或形象）
en: to bring a feeling, a memory or an image into your mind
ex: The music evoked memories of her youth.
这乐曲勾起了她对青年时代的回忆。

zh: 进化
演变；发展；渐进
en: the slow steady development of plants, animals, etc. during the history of the earth, as they adapt to changes in their environment
ex: the evolution of the human species
人类的进化

zh: 进化的；演变的；逐渐发展的
en: in a way that is connected with evolution or with slow steady development and change
ex: an evolutionarily advanced group of insects
进化上先进的昆虫

zh: 进化的；演变的；逐渐发展的
en: connected with evolution; connected with slow steady development and change
ex: evolutionary theory
进化论

zh: 进化论的
en: belief in the theories of evolution and natural selection

zh: a person who believes in the theories of evolution and natural selection
en: a person who believes in the theories of evolution and natural selection

zh: （使）逐渐形成，逐步发展，逐渐演变
进化；演化
en: to develop gradually, especially from a simple to a more complicated form; to develop something in this way
ex: The idea evolved from a drawing I discovered in the attic.
这种想法是从我在阁楼里发现的一幅画得到启发的。

zh: 母羊；雌羊；牝羊
en: a female sheep

zh: （旧时提水用的）大口水壶，大口水罐
en: a large jug used in the past for carrying water

zh: 唷，呃，咦呀（书写形式，表示恶心或厌恶时发出的声音）
en: the way of writing the sound that people make when they think that something is horrible or unpleasant
ex: Eww! There’s a fly in my lemonade!
呃！我的柠檬水里有只苍蝇！

zh: 前妻；前夫；以前的性伴侣
en: a person’s former wife, husband or partner
ex: The children are spending the weekend with my ex and his new wife.
孩子们与我的前夫及其新夫人在一起度周末。

zh: 以职位的权威发言的；权威性地
en: speaking or said with the authority of your position
ex: The Pope was speaking ex cathedra.
教皇以宗座权威发表讲话。

zh: 作为礼物的；作为恩惠的
en: as a gift or favour, not because there is a legal duty to do it
ex: The sum was paid ex gratia.
这是所付的一笔特惠款。

zh: （写于书前页的藏书者姓名前）…的藏书，…的藏本
en: written in the front of a book before the name of the person the book belongs to
ex: ex libris David Harries
戴维 · 哈里斯藏书

zh: 出于工作（或职位、职权）的；（由于工作、职位或职权而成为的）当然的
en: because of your job, rank or position
ex: He was present at the meeting ex officio.
他出于职务需要出席了会议。

zh: 前任
en: former
ex: ex-wife
前妻

zh: 未列入电话号码簿的（经用户要求电话公司不向询问人提供其电话号码）
en: not listed in the public phone book and not available through directory enquiries, at the request of the owner of the phone
ex: an ex-directory number
未列入电话簿的电话号码

zh: 退役的；退伍的
en: having previously been a member of the army, navy, etc.
ex: ex-service personnel
退伍人员

zh: 退役军人；复员军人
en: a man who used to be in the army, navy, etc.
ex: an organization for ex-servicemen
退役军人组织

zh: 退役军人；复员军人
en: a woman who used to be in the army, navy, etc.

zh: 艾（可萨），百亿亿（即 1018）
ex: exajoule
百亿亿焦耳

zh: 使恶化；使加剧；使加重
en: to make something worse, especially a disease or problem
ex: His aggressive reaction only exacerbated the situation.
他的挑衅行为只会使情况恶化。

zh: 使恶化；使加剧；使加重
en: the act of making something worse, especially a disease or problem
ex: the exacerbation of religious and racial tensions
宗教和种族紧张局势的加剧

zh: 精确的；准确的
严谨的；严格的；一丝不苟的
精密的；严密的
en: correct in every detail
ex: The new palace is an exact replica of the original building.
新宫殿是原始建筑的精确复制品。

zh: 严谨细致的；要求小心仔细的；要求严格的
en: needing or demanding a lot of effort and care about details
ex: exacting work
艰巨的工作

zh: 要求；索取
迫使；强迫；强求
en: an act of demanding and getting something from somebody
ex: rising tax exactions
税收征管增加

zh: 精确性；准确性；严密性
en: the quality of being very accurate and exact
ex: scientific exactitude
科学的正确性

zh: 精确地；准确地；确切地
（要求得到更多信息）究竟，到底
（答语，表示赞同或强调正确）一点不错，正是如此，完全正确
en: used to emphasize that something is correct in every way or in every detail
ex: It's exactly nine o'clock.
现在是九点整。

zh: the quality of being correct and accurate in every detail
严谨的；严格的；一丝不苟的
en: the quality of being correct and accurate in every detail
ex: Most people remember with vivid exactness just where they were when the news came through.
大多数人都以生动的精确度记住了新闻发布时的原处。

zh: 夸张；夸大；言过其实
en: to make something seem larger, better, worse or more important than it really is
ex: The hotel was really filthy and I'm not exaggerating.
我不是夸张，这旅店真的很脏。

zh: 夸张的；夸大的；言过其实的
故作姿态的；矫揉造作的
en: made to seem larger, better, worse or more important than it really is or needs to be
ex: to make greatly/grossly/wildly exaggerated claims
提出极为过分的索偿

zh: 夸张的；夸大的；言过其实的
en: in a way that makes something seem larger, better, worse or more important than it really is or needs to be
ex: Some hotels even cut their exaggeratedly high rates by half.
一些酒店甚至将其过高的房价削减了一半。
